abstract: PURPOSE: We assessed the effects of the number of cisplatin, etoposide and bleomycin cycles on long-term renal function. MATERIALS AND METHODS: A total of 157 patients with primary testicular germ cell tumors were treated between 1995 and 2013, of whom 113 (72%) received chemotherapy as the primary intervention. Data were collected retrospectively. The estimated glomerular filtration rate was determined using the Modification of Diet in Renal Disease (MDRD) formula based on pretreatment and last followup visit serum creatinine measurements. Patients who did not receive chemotherapy were compared to those who received cisplatin based chemotherapy. The chemotherapy group was also divided into 3 subgroups according to the number of chemotherapy cycles (2, 3, or 4 or more). RESULTS: At the last followup visit serum creatinine and the estimated glomerular filtration rate significantly differed between the chemotherapy and nonchemotherapy groups. The decrease in the median estimated glomerular filtration rate was significantly greater in the chemotherapy than the nonchemotherapy group (p<0.001). New onset stage 3 chronic kidney disease was observed in 19 patients (12.1%) in the chemotherapy group, including 0%, 5.9%, 13.8% and 20.9% who received 0, 2, 3, or 4 or more chemotherapy cycles, respectively. Except for the difference between the nonchemotherapy group and the 2-cycle chemotherapy group the differences between the groups in new onset chronic stage 3 kidney disease were statistically significant. CONCLUSIONS: Patients with testicular tumors who received cisplatin based chemotherapy showed a significant decrease in the estimated glomerular filtration rate and a significant increase in new onset stage 3 chronic kidney disease compared to patients who received no cycle. However, in patients at high risk with stage I nonseminomatous germ cell tumor who elected 2 cycles of cisplatin, etoposide and bleomycin the chemotherapy had no statistically significant effect on these parameters compared to those in patients who received no chemotherapy.
abstract_ja:
目的:シスプラチン、エトポシド、ブレオマイシンの投与サイクル数が長期の腎機能に及ぼす影響を評価した。
材料と方法:1995年から2013年の間に精巣原発胚細胞腫瘍の157例を治療した。そのうち113例(72%)が一次治療として化学療法を受けた。データは後方視的に収集した。eGFRは治療前と最終外来受診時の血清クレアチニン値に基づき、MDRD式で算出した。化学療法を受けなかった患者を、シスプラチン併用化学療法を受けた患者と比較した。化学療法群はさらに投与サイクル数(2、3、4以上)で3群に分けた。
結果:最終外来受診時の血清クレアチニンとeGFRは、化学療法群と非化学療法群で有意に異なった。中央値のeGFR低下は、化学療法群の方が非化学療法群より有意に大きかった(p<0.001)。新規に生じた病期3の慢性腎臓病は化学療法群の19例(12.1%)で認められ、投与サイクル数0、2、3、4以上でそれぞれ0%、5.9%、13.8%、20.9%だった。非化学療法群と2サイクル群の差を除き、新規病期3慢性腎臓病の群間差は統計学的に有意であった。
結論:シスプラチン併用化学療法を受けた精巣腫瘍患者は、無治療の患者と比べてeGFRの有意な低下と、新規病期3慢性腎臓病の有意な増加を示した。しかし、2サイクルのシスプラチン・エトポシド・ブレオマイシンを受けた高リスク病期I非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の患者では、化学療法は非化学療法群と比べてこれらの指標に統計学的に有意な影響を与えなかった。
